# m.reference.tickers

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Tickers of stocks, OTC securities, indices, forex, and crypto, with listing details.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.reference.tickers(symbols=None, *, market=None, ticker_type=None, exchange=None, cusip=None, cik=None, as_of=None, active=True, search=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None, on_error=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Symbol`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Tickers to look up. Leave it out for every ticker; `dm.ALL` is refused. |
| `market` | The market to list, a `dm.Market` member such as `dm.Market.STOCKS`. Leave it out for every market. |
| `ticker_type` | The type, a `dm.TickerType` member such as `dm.TickerType.ETF`. `ticker_types()` lists them. Leave it out for every type. |
| `exchange` | The primary exchange's MIC, such as `"XNAS"`. Leave it out for every exchange. |
| `cusip` | The CUSIP to look up. |
| `cik` | The SEC Central Index Key to look up. |
| [`as_of`](README.md#as_of) | The day the listing is as of. Leave it out for today. |
| `active` | True, the default, lists tickers traded on `as_of`. False lists delisted ones. |
| `search` | Text to match against the ticker and the company name. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Any of Massive's field names, such as `"name"`. Fields: `ticker`, `name`, `market`, `locale`, `primary_exchange`, `type`, `currency_symbol`, `currency_name`, `base_currency_symbol`, `base_currency_name`, `cik`, `composite_figi`, `share_class_figi`, `last_updated_utc`, `delisted_utc`. |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | Per ticker when tickers are named, else in total. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters. Keys: `ticker_gt`, `ticker_gte`, `ticker_lt`, `ticker_lte`. |
| [`on_error`](README.md#on_error) | What a bad symbol or row does in this call (`dm.ErrorPolicy`). None, the default, takes each cause from the session's `MassiveConfig.on_error`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | All Tickers (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Currencies Basic | crypto: Updated as needed, 2 years; forex: Updated hourly, 2 years |
| Currencies Starter | crypto: Updated as needed, All history; forex: Updated hourly, All history |
| Currencies Business | crypto: Updated as needed, All history; forex: Updated hourly, All history |
| Indices Basic | Updated hourly, All history |
| Indices Starter | Updated hourly, All history |
| Indices Advanced | Updated hourly, All history |
| Indices Business | Updated hourly, All history |
| Stocks Basic | Updated daily, 2 years |
| Stocks Starter | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Developer | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Business | Updated daily, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From REST `ticker`: "The exchange symbol that this item is traded under." |
| `Active` | Boolean | Whether or not the asset is actively traded. False means the asset has been delisted. |
| `BaseCurrencyName` | String | The name of the currency that this asset is priced against. |
| `BaseCurrencySymbol` | String | The ISO 4217 code of the currency that this asset is priced against. |
| `Cik` | String | The CIK number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_Index_Key). |
| `CompositeFigi` | String | The composite OpenFIGI number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://www.openfigi.com/about/figi) |
| `CurrencyName` | String | The name of the currency that this asset is traded with. |
| `CurrencySymbol` | String | The ISO 4217 code of the currency that this asset is traded with. |
| `DelistedUtc` | Instant | The last date that the asset was traded. |
| `LastUpdatedUtc` | Instant | The information is accurate up to this time. |
| `Locale` | String | The locale of the asset. |
| `Market` | String | The market type of the asset. |
| `Name` | String | The name of the asset. For stocks/equities this will be the companies registered name. For crypto/fx this will be the name of the currency or coin pair. |
| `PrimaryExchange` | String | The ISO code of the primary listing exchange for this asset. |
| `ShareClassFigi` | String | The share Class OpenFIGI number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://www.openfigi.com/about/figi) |
| `Type` | String | The type of the asset. Find the types that we support via our Ticker Types API (https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/tickers/ticker-types). |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
